meta_description:
2,969 likes, 54 comments - unicef on October 29, 2026: "“This is not a ceasefire. This is a slow death,” says Nisreen, grandmother to three-year-old Rital in Gaza.

Rital was injured in an attack in July 2026 that also killed her mother and grandfather, while her father was killed earlier in the war.

Rital is still waiting for surgery related to the injuries she sustained.

Nisreen is doing everything to support Rital’s needs, but over a year since the ceasefire was announced in Gaza, childhood is still defined by survival. 

UNICEF is helping hundreds of thousands of children and families with health, nutrition, learning and psychosocial support services.

A ceasefire that does not protect children has failed them.

Children in Gaza must be protected as a priority.".
